name: run-comparison
description: The peer-comparison export of the gauntlet harness, Tools/gauntlet/harness/run.mjs (comparisons), and its Jet twin, the Comparison module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/Comparison.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver over a directory of entries with their language rows and Jet tiers: batch, batch-steps, service, web and web-app entries; run-tier, compiled and expert peers and their matched Jet rows; declared, undeclared and null not-applicable peers, missing, failed and broken peer rows and a non-string language; structural, own-metric, whole-language and invalid metric-applicability facts; ready, failed and missing Jet tiers and gated cache states, with the run cell carrying the first unsettled state or else the highest ratio; sub-millisecond runtime and service readings with and without paired timer or probe evidence; and missing or invalid Jet and peer metrics.
